question:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding the directive principles of state policy given in the Indian constitution?

I. They are not enforceable by any court.

II. It shall be the duty of the state to apply these principles in making laws.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)** are enshrined in **Part IV** of the Indian Constitution, covering **Articles 36 to 51**. 
• **Statement I:** The Directive Principles are **not enforceable by any court** (Article 37). This means that no individual can approach the judiciary to enforce these principles, as they are not justiciable. ***Hence, this statement is correct.***
